brief:
Israel has approved plans to construct 650 new settlement units south of Jerusalem, Shehab Wire reported. The expansion would add substantially to the existing settlement infrastructure in areas surrounding the occupied Palestinian capital.

The announcement marks the latest in a series of Israeli settlement developments in territories claimed by Palestinians for a future state. Construction of settlements in the West Bank and East Jerusalem is considered illegal under international law, though Israel disputes this characterization. The scale of the planned units underscores the ongoing expansion of Israeli settlements in areas south of the city.
